metadata.description: Version 1 request envelope of vibe prompt capture --json: the instruction blocks a supported adapter builds from the prepared materials, in order and each in an explicit API role, the declared position of the tool block, the caller's own band-T messages, and the recommended cache-boundary offsets. A filename chooses no API role and the envelope says which role it chose. Cache diagnostics appear only when a provider's own usage record was supplied, because write, read and uncached token counts are read from a provider and never computed here.

The tool block's declared place in the request. vibe contributes no tools, and says where they go rather than leaving the question open: a provider's cache hierarchy puts the tool list ahead of the instructions, so a changed tool set invalidates every later block.

One instruction block: its band, the API role the adapter placed it in, where its bytes came from, the digest of the bytes observed for this request, and its byte offset from the first instruction byte. `text` is present only under --with-text.
One band-T message: the caller's own task content, which vibe never witnesses and never invents. It sits after every instruction block, in the message role.

Cache diagnostics read out of one provider usage record. Each counter appears only when that provider reported it: a number the provider did not report is absent, never zero and never derived from the others. Not a cache claim — a reading.
